critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 5410 lines — Marketing/Social section alone spans ~500 lines. Consider extracting to /app/backend/routers/social.py to keep files under the 700-line guideline.

DELETE /api/social/posts/{id} and DELETE /api/social/media/{id} always return {ok: true} even when the id doesn't belong to the caller's org (delete_one silently). Isolation is preserved (nothing is actually removed thanks to org_id filter) but returning 404 on missing would be more RESTful and less confusing. Same for DELETE /api/social/accounts.

social_settings_put uses PUT semantics but performs a partial $set (exclude_unset). Behaviour is fine and desirable but the HTTP verb technically implies full replacement — either document this as PATCH-like or switch to PATCH.
_plan_dates cap at 40 posts and hard-coded to first preferred_time only; consider distributing across multiple preferred_times when provided.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase D (Instagram/Meta publishing + autopilot cron) is intentionally NOT implemented; only the account scaffold saves a handle with status 'pending_connection'. Do not attempt real OAuth. All /api/social/* endpoints are org-scoped via oq(user). The stat card testids are of the form stat-<italianLabel> (e.g., stat-Bozze, stat-Approvati) not stat-draft/etc. The Emergent LLM key is live so AI calls take ~8-15s each; give generous timeouts.
